On net, notwithstanding significant crosscurrents, inflation seems likely to remain subdued for some time.
the unemployment rate likely will decline only slowly if economic growth remains moderate, as I expect.
some important headwinds--in particular, constrained bank lending and a weak job market--likely will prevent the expansion from being as robust as we would hope.
to support home lending through our purchases of mortgage-backed securities
